texts: Render Lab reads the skeleton before it renders anything. Open it with an avatar and it reports the rig it found, here a skeleton with 65 bones, then lays out the poses that rig can take. The contact sheet under it is 24 live renders at 256px, each one a real call to the render API, with no account and no key.
Click any tile and it loads into the composer with its pose and framing set, ready to copy as a call. Try it on your own avatar at three.ws/render-lab.
